# sendgrid_partner_account (Resource)

Provisions a SendGrid partner sub-account via the Partner Accounts API. This is an enterprise feature: the configured provider API key must belong to a SendGrid reseller/partner account with partner-provisioning privileges. Calling this against an ordinary account's API key will fail with an authorization error.

~> `profile` cannot be read back from the API after creation (SendGrid does not expose an endpoint to retrieve it), so changing it forces replacement rather than an in-place update.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_partner_account" "customer" {
  profile = {
    first_name      = "Sender"
    last_name       = "Wiz"
    company_name    = "Example Co"
    company_website = "https://example.com"
    email           = "mail@example.com"
    timezone        = "Asia/Tokyo"
  }

  offerings = [
    {
      name     = "org.ei.free.v1"
      type     = "package"
      quantity = 1
    },
  ]

  state = "activated"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `offerings` (Attributes List) The package and add-on offerings assigned to this account. An account may have exactly one `package` offering. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--offerings))

### Optional

- `profile` (Attributes) The account holder's profile, supplied only at creation time. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profile))
- `state` (String) The account's state. Settable values are `activated` and `deactivated`; SendGrid may independently transition an account to `suspended`, `banned`, or `indeterminate`, which this attribute will reflect on the next read but which cannot be set here.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The provisioned account's SendGrid account ID.
- `created_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of when the account was created.
- `id` (String) The provisioned account's ID (identical to `account_id`).

<a id="nestedatt--offerings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `offerings`

Required:

- `name` (String) The offering's name (e.g. `org.ei.free.v1`).
- `type` (String) The offering type: `package` or `addon`.

Optional:

- `quantity` (Number) The quantity of this offering. Must be `1` for `package` offerings.


<a id="nestedatt--profile"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profile`

Optional:

- `company_name` (String) The account holder's company name.
- `company_website` (String) The account holder's company website.
- `email` (String) The account holder's email address.
- `first_name` (String) The account holder's first name.
- `last_name` (String) The account holder's last name.
- `phone` (String) The account holder's phone number, in E.164 format.
- `timezone` (String) The account holder's IANA time zone (e.g. `Asia/Tokyo`).
